svg.title: Run the agent on AWS. Follow each request.
svg.desc: An explicitly built ARM64 image is pushed to ECR and selected for AgentCore Runtime. CDK defines infrastructure. At runtime configured OpenTelemetry exports operation spans and logs to CloudWatch.
svg.text: Run the agent on AWS. Follow each request.
Deployment happens when releasing a version; tracing happens when the application runs.
Inspect the same question across workflow steps, retrieval and results. Export / account configuration is required.
A release changes the running image. Individual chatbot requests do not rebuild or redeploy it.
